newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China President Jiang to attend HK handover - radio.
newsitem.headline: China President Jiang to attend HK handover - radio.

text.p: Chinese President and Communist Party boss Jiang Zemin will visit Hong Kong for the British colony's handover to China, Hong Kong government-run radio said on Thursday.
The report was not immediately confirmed by British or Chinese officials meeting for the second day of diplomatic talks on details of the event including the handover ceremony.
But the radio said Jiang would attend, and it quoted British delegation leader Hugh Davies as saying China was expected to be represented at the most senior level.
Davies also said that heir to the throne Prince Charles would represent Britain at the midnight June 30 ceremony.

An editor at the radio station said it had learned from a source at the diplomatic negotiations that an announcement on the attendance of state leaders would probably be made after the three-day talks, which finish on Friday.

If Jiang comes, it will be the first time a Chinese head of state, or any Communist head of state from any country, has set foot in Hong Kong, a bastion of capitalism since Britain seized it from the Manchu dynasty of imperial China in 1841.
